COMMUNITY RULES

1. Christ First - Everything we do is to glorify Jesus.
2. Respect Everyone - No insult, no tribalism, no hate speech.
3. No Judgment - No question is stupid. Ask freely.
4. Keep It Pure - No sexual content, nude images, or dirty jokes.
5. No Spamming - No ads, betting links, or self-promotion.
6. Confidentiality - What is shared here stays here. Don't screenshot prayers.
7. No Inbox Request - Don't ask "DM me" in public. Stay safe, especially ladies.
8. Encourage, Don't Argue - Correct with scripture, not anger.
9. No False Doctrine - Don't teach what is not in the Bible.
10. Be Honest - No fake testimonies or fake miracles for likes.
11. No Politics - No political party campaigns or insults to leaders.
12. Use Clean Language - No cursing, even short forms like wtf.
13. Stay On Topic - Post in the right category (Youth / Bible / Life).
14. No Personal Attacks - Attack the idea, not the person.
15. Pray Before You Reply - Don't reply to hurt, reply to heal.
16. No Private Info - Don't post your phone number, school address or nude photo.
17. Help The Weak - If someone is depressed, encourage, don't ignore.
18. No Money Requests - No asking for money or "send MoMo" here.
19. Youth Leaders Are Final - Respect admin/moderator decisions.
20. We Are Family - No one prays alone. Lift one, drop one.

Break the rules = Warning → Post Deleted → 7-Day Ban → Permanent Ban. Keep this altar holy. 🙏
